figurative_meaning_en: The auspicious first glance between bride and groom
example_sentences_in_bangla: বিয়ের দিন বর-কনের মুখচন্দ্রিকা দেখে সকলে আশীর্বাদ করল।
তাদের মুখচন্দ্রিকা মুহূর্তটি অত্যন্ত সুন্দর ছিল।
example_sentences_in_english: On the wedding day, everyone blessed the couple upon their first auspicious glance.
Their moment of first sight was beautifully auspicious.
history: This idiom draws from traditional Bengali wedding rituals where the bride and groom's first mutual glance is considered a moment of blessing and harmony.
note: Refers to the poetic glow of faces during the first look in marriage ceremonies.
